accessibility:
- **The name follows the words:** with its label shown, the button has no `aria-label`, so its name
  is the text on it, "Copy" and then "Copied", and a voice control user can say what they see
  ([WCAG 2.5.3](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/label-in-name.html)).
- **The result is announced:** a change to a focused button's label isn't read out by every screen
  reader and browser pairing, so each copy, and each failure, is also a polite `role="status"`
  message
  ([WCAG 4.1.3](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/status-messages.html), technique
  [ARIA22](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Techniques/aria/ARIA22)). The region is in the page from
  hydration, well before any click, and is visually hidden. It's portaled to the end of the page,
  or to a `ConfigProvider`'s `portalContainer`, so it isn't a child of the button's `Control` or
  `Buttons` row. A copy repeated while the button still reads "Copied" is announced again.
- **Icon-only, it's still named:** `labels.copy` is its `aria-label` in both states, since there are
  no words to follow, and only the glyph swaps. Give it a name that says what it copies when there
  are several on a page ("Copy the Production key").
- **The glyphs are decorative:** both render `aria-hidden="true"`; the label and the status carry the
  meaning.
- **Failures aren't hidden:** a copy that didn't happen never shows "Copied".
- **Keyboard and focus:** it's a native `<button type="button">`, so <kbd>Enter</kbd> and
  <kbd>Space</kbd> copy, focus stays on it, and it never submits the form it sits in.
- **Forced colors:** the glyphs are drawn in `currentColor`, so they take the system's button text
  color.
summary: The `CopyButton` component renders a button that copies a piece of text to the clipboard, says "Copied" for a moment, and announces the result. It's a `Button` with a copy icon and "Copy", and takes everything `Button` takes. A click writes `value` through the Clipboard API, or through the older copy command where that's missing or refused, and reports a failure rather than showing "Copied". Each outcome is announced through a polite status region portaled out of the button's place, so it stays the last child of a `Control` or `Buttons`. With `showLabel={false}` it's an `IconButton`. For a trigger of your own, use `useClipboard`, which it's built on.

parts.summary: The `CopyButton` component renders a button that copies a piece of text to the clipboard, says "Copied" for a moment, and announces the result. It's a `Button` with a copy icon and "Copy", and takes everything `Button` takes. A click writes `value` through the Clipboard API, or through the older copy command where that's missing or refused, and reports a failure rather than showing "Copied". Each outcome is announced through a polite status region portaled out of the button's place, so it stays the last child of a `Control` or `Buttons`. With `showLabel={false}` it's an `IconButton`. For a trigger of your own, use `useClipboard`, which it's built on.

props.name: value
props.description: The text it copies. This is not the `<button>`'s form value, which it doesn't render.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long the "Copied" label stays, in milliseconds. Another copy restarts it.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Shows the label beside the icon, which is then the button's name: it carries no `aria-label`, so the name reads "Copy" and then "Copied" as the words on it do. Turned off, it's a square icon-only button named by `labels.copy` through `aria-label` in both states, and only the glyph changes. An `aria-label` you pass yourself names it in either form.

props.name: labels
props.type: { copy?: string; copied?: string; copiedStatus?: string; failedStatus?: string }
props.description: Translations for the label and the announcements.

props.name: onCopiedChange
props.description: Called with `true` after each copy that worked, a repeat included, and with `false` when `duration` runs out or a later copy fails.

props.name: onCopyError
props.description: Called when neither the Clipboard API nor the fallback could write. A copy field can select its text from here, so the reader can copy it themselves.

props.name: color
props.description: Bulma color variant for the button. `ghost` renders a link-like button; `text` renders a minimal text-only button.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Displays a loading spinner, with everything inside the button hidden behind it, in forced colors (Windows' contrast themes) too. Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the spinner stops and stays drawn. Bulma alone hides only the label, so the rest needs bestax's CSS loaded.

props.name: isFullWidth
props.deprecationNote: Use `isFullwidth` instead — `isFullwidth` wins if both are set.

props.name: isActive
props.description: Applies active styling (visual only), with no `aria-pressed`. For a button that stays pressed, use `ToggleButton`.
